name: Huỳnh Vĩnh Tiến
content: My current goal is to become a Front-End programmer and through the working process I will learn other frameworks to become a Full-Stack programmer, I really want to work for the company and from there I can use the knowledge and skills learned in school to apply to the company's real projects and demonstrate my good characteristics to support people around me and fulfill my assigned responsibilities to join hands to support the company to expand and develop sustainably.
